name: APEX-032-25 ORM Injection via Sequelize Operators
description: 一个使用Sequelize ORM的Node.js API，存在操作符注入漏洞。用户输入直接传递给Sequelize查询，使攻击者能够利用$ne、$like、$or等操作符绕过身份验证并访问未授权数据。
hint: 登录接口将请求体直接传入ORM查询，尝试用对象类型替代字符串绕过密码验证。

vulnerability.root_cause: User input passed directly to Sequelize query operators

description.en: A Node.js API using Sequelize ORM with operator injection vulnerabilities. User input is passed directly to Sequelize queries, allowing attackers to use operators like $ne, $like, $or to bypass authentication and access unauthorized data.

hint.en: 登录接口将请求体直接传入ORM查询，尝试用对象类型替代字符串绕过密码验证
